profileLabel: Near-neutral economics (low confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Parañaque 2nd District representative with 147 principal-authored bills. Authored travel-tax abolition, presidential suspension of petroleum excise tax, a higher individual income-tax exemption ceiling, minimum corporate tax relief for micro and small enterprises and a false-information penalty. Co-authored a plastic-bag excise, a tax amnesty and climate and disaster risk financing.
caveat: Mostly direction-neutral tax relief. The false-information penalty is one speech issue, so civil liberties is not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Tax relief package is direction-neutral to mildly regressive (0): travel tax, fuel excise, MSE minimum-tax exemption. Co-authored climate and disaster risk financing (-1). Two issues, weak signal.
